title: HMICommandReply
description: Reply to a command sent to the topic 'HMIControl.<source>' (for scenario commands, see the reply of the corresponding command)

control_uid.description: Unique identifier of the control, carried by its acknowledgement (published on 'Acknowledgement.<location>.<subtopic>', or in the acknowledgement field below for real_time_critical controls)

acknowledgement.description: Only present for real_time_critical controls: acknowledgement of the control, null if the control or its acknowledgement was dropped

control_uid.description: Unique identifier of the acknowledged control

value.description: Value of the acknowledged control (as received by its destination)

source.description: Cyber node sending the acknowledgement (destination of the control)

destination.description: Cyber node receiving the acknowledgement (sender of the control)

control_time_sent.description: Simulation time at which the control was sent (real-time clock)

time_sent.description: Simulation time at which the control reached its destination, and the acknowledgement was sent

time_received.description: Simulation time at which the acknowledgement reaches the sender of the control: the caller should wait until then
